systems.fixed_airflow: Healthcare adaptation of the classroom fixed Airflow architecture; authoritative task bodies, one ordinary load-task retry. Scheduler execution is audited separately.
systems.simple_agentic: Completed Part 2: healthcare adaptation of the classroom simple agentic architecture, unchanged.
systems.adaptive_multi_agent: Part 3: custom specialist selection, validation routing and bounded database recovery.

methodology.data: Read PostgreSQL once, freeze the raw HAI_1_SIR records, and prepare identical seed-42 splits for every system within each case.
methodology.faults: Injected at the shared loader boundary; no production table is modified.
methodology.timing: In-process workflow wall time including artifacts, excluding container startup and Airflow scheduler overhead. Fixed ordinary retry delay is five seconds.
methodology.suite_success: All adaptive cases pass; all observations satisfy instrumentation, split, budget and artifact controls. Baseline capability gaps are findings, not hidden or redefined as successes.

cases.name: normal_snapshot
cases.expected_outcome: Complete with disjoint splits, finite MAE and saved metrics/predictions.
cases.scoring_criterion: All completion, split, finite-metric, artifact and cohort-agreement checks true.

cases.name: constant_target
cases.expected_outcome: Select the median predictor without claiming improvement over its zero validation error.
cases.scoring_criterion: Median selected; validation MAE equals baseline; no claimed positive improvement.

not_applicable.fixed_airflow: Intentionally always evaluates Ridge; adaptive predictor selection is unsupported. Its zero-error metrics are still recorded.

cases.name: ridge_improves
cases.expected_outcome: Ridge is selected and genuinely improves validation MAE over the median baseline.
cases.scoring_criterion: Selected Ridge and at least 5% lower validation MAE; adaptive decisions use validation only.

cases.name: one_transient_read_failure
cases.expected_outcome: Recover and complete within the declared retry budget; Part 3 must visit Recovery Coordinator.
cases.scoring_criterion: Completion, exactly two read attempts and one retry; Part 3 recovery node is present.
cases.capability_note: Fixed Airflow may recover through its ordinary retry. Part 2 has no retry; its failure is retained as a failed capability comparison.

cases.name: persistent_read_failure
cases.expected_outcome: Terminate with a database failure and no model fitting within each system's read-call limit.
cases.scoring_criterion: Database failure, zero fits, read calls equal retry allowance plus one, and no test evaluation.

cases.name: missing_required_column
cases.expected_outcome: Reject missing score before fitting with a clear schema error.
cases.scoring_criterion: Schema error, zero fits, no test evaluation; Part 3 does not enter recovery.

cases.name: conflicting_facility
cases.expected_outcome: Reject conflicting facility records before fitting; no silent deduplication.
cases.scoring_criterion: Data-integrity error, zero fits, no test evaluation or adaptive recovery.

cases.name: test_target_isolation
cases.expected_outcome: Identical routing, alphas, predictor selection and validation decisions across the paired runs.
cases.scoring_criterion: Exact equality of tuning signatures; test MAE changes, proving the perturbation reached final evaluation.

cases.name: model_attempt_budget
cases.expected_outcome: Model limits are respected; the weak-signal stress fixture exercises the three-fit cap in the adaptive systems.
cases.scoring_criterion: Fixed uses one fit; simple/adaptive use three unique alphas; zero model/retry budget violations.
